Paintings behind the Portinari palettes

Source: R/works.R
portinari.works.Rd

The works each palette was drawn from, with links to the collection pages. The sequential palettes guerra_azul and paz_ouro are derived from guerra and paz and share their works.

Usage

portinari.works(palette = NULL)

Arguments

palette

Optional character vector of palette names to filter by.

Value

A data frame with columns palette, title, year, collection, inventory, url (collection or story page) and image_url (the museum's image, where one is published; NA otherwise).

portinari.works()

#> 2        cafe
#> 3  retirantes
#> 4  retirantes
#> 5  retirantes
